trust_roots.role: workload identity, execution isolation, build and trace APIs
trust_roots.assumption: Google Cloud returns authentic control-plane observations for the named project.
trust_roots.compromise_impact: A compromised control plane could produce authentic-looking but false infrastructure observations.

trust_roots.role: read-only recomputation and sole continuity attestation
trust_roots.assumption: The verifier workload identity and its deployed code are not controlled by an executor.
trust_roots.compromise_impact: A compromised verifier could attest a semantically invalid lifecycle.

trust_roots.assumption: The official services accurately report the queried public identifiers at observation time.
trust_roots.compromise_impact: An incorrect upstream record can remain internally consistent and still be factually wrong.

trust_roots.assumption: GitHub reports the state of the identified synthetic issue accurately.
trust_roots.compromise_impact: A compromised provider can misreport or mutate the external effect.
